$comment: Tabs / segmented control. The TRACK (rail) and the idle label are owned here. The ACTIVE indicator is not — it reuses the Badge component tokens (--badge-bg-*, --badge-radius, --badge-border-*, --badge-padding-*, --badge-fg, --badge-font-*) directly in Tabs.css, so an active tab renders pixel-for-pixel as a Badge of the same hue. Badge is the single source of truth for the pill.
